description: CrossData - Regionalplanung - Wasser - Hochwasser is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by rpv-elbtalosterz.de. Regional planning definitions of the spatial use of water and flood complex are presented for the German-Czech cross-border cooperation of the planning authorities. The dataset contains data from the planning regions Oberes Elbtal/Osterzgebirge, Region Chemnitz and Oberlausitz-Lower Silesia in the final state. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Crossdata – Regional Planning – Water – Floods" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RNK, Regionalplanung, oblast rezervací, VBG Ort: landesweit, VBG vorbeugender Hochwasserschutz, územní plánování. The listing shows 2025-05-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
